en.title: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based): CVE-2026-118306 Memory corruption in FileSystem
en.summary: A critical memory corruption vulnerability exists in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) within the FileSystem component, tracked as CVE-2026-118306.
en.impact: The vulnerability allows memory corruption via the FileSystem component.
en.fix: The sources do not state fixed versions.
checks: Check systems for the presence of the Microsoft 2026-Oct security update.
